doc.title: Ray Ricker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 27, 2022

title: Closing remarks
summary: Rowe thanks Ricker, who mentions plans to write again, and they say goodbye.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: That’s wonderful. Well you’ve had a terrific career and I’ve enjoyed this conversation so much. And I wish you continued activity and creativity.
That’s the way to do it. Yeah. I’m still — I’m thinking of getting back, getting the old Finale going here and doing some stuff. I’ve got some ideas and things I want to try.
Well I have a saxophone ensemble here who’d be glad to read anything you write.
Okay. Well thanks very much for asking me, Monk, I appreciate it.
Thanks. I’m going to sign off and then we’ll say our good-byes.
